name: BJ's One Mastercard
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee on the card itself (requires paid BJ's membership)
balance_transfer_fee: None for balances transferred at the Balance Transfer APR

verdict.text: Only useful layered onto a BJ's membership you already pay for

earn_rates.category: In-club at BJ's, BJs.com & the BJ's app
BJ's Gas, discount at the pump, not a rewards rate

earn_note: This is the base tier: 3% at BJ's and 1.5% everywhere else, paired with a BJ's Club membership ($60/yr). The richer BJ's One+ card earns 5%/2% but requires the pricier BJ's Club+ membership ($120/yr); don't confuse the two. Gas at BJ's Gas is a 10¢/gal discount at the pump, not rewards, and BJ's Gas purchases don't earn. Eye exams, tax, bottle deposits, alcohol, tobacco, lottery, gift cards and propane don't earn, and neither do same-day delivery and pickup fees, BJ's Gas, or purchases through PayPal and other third-party wallets.

redemption_options.method: At BJ's checkout in-club, on BJs.com or in the BJ's app, toward purchases or membership fees

points.per_100k: Not applicable: rewards accrue as a dollar balance, not a points currency
points.note: A flat cash-back balance, not points. You can redeem once it reaches $10, but you have to use all the rewards presented to you at once, on a purchase of at least $10. Rewards can also pay your BJ's membership fee. They're yours for the life of the account, with no cash-out to a bank account or statement credit; they're locked to BJ's.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners and no travel redemption: rewards are a closed-loop balance usable only at BJ's.

protection_note: A bare-bones retail Mastercard with none of the usual Mastercard World/World Elite protection suite documented in its terms: no purchase protection, no extended warranty, no travel coverage. Treat it as a pure earn-and-redeem tool, not a card to charge big purchases on for protection reasons.
rental_note: No rental car coverage of any kind.

services.name: BJ's membership required
services.detail: You must be an active, paying BJ's member (BJ's Club, $60/yr) to apply for or use this card; it's not a substitute for membership and doesn't discount it. BJ's B2B and Global Sales memberships aren't eligible.

services.name: Card lock & account management
services.detail: Mobile app card lock, autopay, and flexible due-date selection via Capital One's servicing platform.

services.name: World Mastercard benefits
services.detail: Mastercard ID Theft Protection (enrollment required), Travel & Lifestyle Services, Airport Concierge (15% off meet-and-greet) and Digital Merchant Offers.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns the same rewards rate (into your account)

additional_cards.note: Free to add, but the household still needs its own BJ's membership card at the register; this credit card doesn't grant club access on its own.

timeline.text: Capital One took over as issuer from Comenity, relaunching the BJ's Perks Plus Mastercard as BJ's One and the BJ's Perks Elite Mastercard as BJ's One+, on the Mastercard network.
